finding: The old 16-bucket PC/address hash counted recurring exceptions over the session even when the same thread delivered other exceptions between visits.
change: Count consecutive identical guest exception deliveries per exact Mach-thread identity. Other threads do not reset a failing thread. A different PC/address or exempt alignment delivery on that thread resets its sequence.
host_validation: Production counter passes recurring-work, stuck-loop, other-thread isolation, full identity, alignment exemption and bounded capacity cases. Real iPhoneOS signal handler compiles.

native_build_archive.change: consecutive per-thread exception delivery counter; terminal threshold unchanged

device_execution: Signed Build 11 installed, with checked game/settings/library data and all embedded PE farms preserved. New game reaches credits and forest, then remaining consecutive fault reaches terminal. See ipad-m2-dreaming-sarah-entry-scene.json.
limitations: This corrects a proven accumulation error; it does not prove every logged native protection fault is legitimate.
Repeated same-PC/address work without intervening guest exception deliveries can still reach the threshold.
A bounded table may evict a thread when more than 64 distinct threads are concurrently represented.
